subject: general
question: Six boys A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the center (not necessarily in the same order). One boy sits between C and D. One boy sits between A and B. C is not the neighbor of F. A sits immediate left of E. Who sits immediate right of F?
solution:
**Step 1:** A sits immediate left of E. One boy sits between A and B

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5a2bd1cc731961fc0d0e483f65b5660e748f553522e4ad2b670734e43b33bb9.png] 

Step 2: One boy sits between C and D and C is not the neighbor of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/383d756ad5c759d78c78e129e8dc92880ee799236fe875255d908b5d58cc301f.png] 

Hence, the boy sits immediate right of F is D.

Hence, **the correct answer is D.**
